description: This file implements the RequestHandler class, which manages lifecycle requests, initialization, termination, and interactions with other components such as RippleHandler, RuntimeManagerHandler, and WindowManagerHandler within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing lifecycle requests, initialization, termination, and communication with other components within the plugin framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RequestHandler, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RequestHandler with the provided service and event handler, setting up Ripple, RuntimeManager, and WindowManager components.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up the RequestHandler and its associated components.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Attempts to launch an application with the specified context and intent, updating its lifecycle state.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Requests termination of the application in the given context.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent to the application identified by the context.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the lifecycle state of the application based on the provided context and target state.
